description: This file declares the SessionServerAppFactory class, which implements the ISessionServerAppFactory interface. It provides methods to create session server application instances with specified environment variables, path, timeout, and permissions. The class is part of the rialto::servermanager::common namespace and is used for managing session server applications within the Rialto project.

classes.name: SessionServerAppFactory
classes.description: Implements the ISessionServerAppFactory interface to create session server application instances with specified configuration parameters.

methods.name: SessionServerAppFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with environment variables, session server path, startup timeout, and socket permissions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ISessionServerApp instance with specified application name, initial state, app configuration, and session server app manager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ISessionServerApp instance with only the session server app manager.
